title: Kanda 1: Prayers for Health and Protection
summary: Charms and prayers for retaining divine knowledge and curing ailments.
ai_summary: The first book contains mystical formulas directed at ensuring long life, intellectual retention (Medha), and overcoming adversities.

verses.sanskrit:
ये त्रिषप्ताः परियन्ति विश्वा रूपाणि बिभ्रतः ।
वाचस्पतिर्बला तेषां तन्वो अद्य दधातु मे ॥
verses.transliteration:
ye triṣaptāḥ pariyanti viśvā rūpāṇi bibhrataḥ |
vācaspatirbalā teṣāṃ tanvo adya dadhātu me ||
verses.translation: The thrice-seven that go about, bearing all forms—let the Lord of Speech (Vachaspati) assign to me today their powers and bodies.

layers.content: वे तीन-सात (इक्कीस तत्त्व) जो सभी रूपों को धारण करते हुए सर्वत्र व्याप्त हैं—वाचस्पति (वाणी के स्वामी) आज मेरे भीतर उनके बल और स्वरूप को स्थापित करें।
ते तीन-सात (एकवीस तत्त्वे) जे सर्व रूपे धारण करून सर्वत्र संचार करतात—वाचस्पती (वाणीचा स्वामी) आज माझ्या शरीरात त्यांचे बळ स्थापित करोत.

layers.author: sayana
layers.content: The 'thrice-seven' refers to the 21 principles of the universe (or the 21 types of sounds). This is a prayer for Medha (intellectual retention).
